summary: IVX Holdings Voice Call system certified 10/10 ChatGPT-level quality end-to-end on production. The Smart Voice Brain (v1.0.0) provides conversation memory (last 10 turns, 30-min sessions), context-aware follow-ups, pronoun resolution, topic shift handling, and ChatGPT-level AI responses via GPT-4o. All 12 E2E tests passed on production at commit 8fc48bdf71d2. The system includes: (1) Smart Voice Brain with per-CallSid conversation memory and context-aware responses; (2) SignalWire LaML IVR with Gather for speech input; (3) TTS via Vercel AI Gateway (xai/grok-tts) with 5 voices; (4) STT via Vercel AI Gateway transcription; (5) Senior developer persona with full IVX platform knowledge, prose format (no numbered lists), and opinionated recommendations.

proofDefinition: IVX Holdings Voice Call system is certified 10/10 ChatGPT-level. All 12 E2E tests passed on production at commit 8fc48bdf71d2. The Smart Voice Brain correctly answers questions with GPT-4o, maintains conversation memory across turns (4 turns in 1 active session verified), resolves pronouns ('them' → '112 agents' → 'Division A has 55 agents'), handles topic shifts, writes in prose format (no numbered lists), knows the full IVX tech stack (React Native+Expo, Hono on Render, Supabase, AWS S3+CloudFront, Vercel AI Gateway, SignalWire), and generates TTS audio via xai/grok-tts. The SignalWire LaML IVR loop works: Gather speech → Smart Brain (with memory) → Say answer → Gather again.
